purpose: `permits: {}` declares zero authority, equal to an absent `permits:` block: an effect is refused; a pure-compute builtin (e.g. jq) requires no tools grant.
title: Declared zero authority

purpose: A `when:` CEL boolean on local namespaces gates a task: false settles it skipped; an `after: { <task>: skipped }` edge admits an alternative. An explicit relation (e.g. `== true`) is required; a bare `${{ inputs.flag }}` root is refused.
title: Guard a task on an input flag

purpose: An `outputs:` entry written as `{ value, type, description }` declares a type; untyped, an entry is a bare `${{ tasks.<id>.output }}` reference.
title: Typed output entry
